tips.title: Time to get out
tips.body: You're badly hurt. Stairs are your best escape, because only monsters right next to you follow. A potion of curing or heal wounds buys time too.

tips.title: You're poisoned
tips.body: Poison drains your HP over time and can finish you off. A potion of curing clears it.

tips.title: You're on fire
tips.body: Keep moving to burn it off faster, or step into water to put it out.

tips.title: You're stuck
tips.body: Move in any direction to struggle free. You can't walk or fight until you do.

tips.title: You're confused
tips.body: You may stumble the wrong way, and you can't read scrolls until it wears off.

tips.title: Choosing a target
tips.body: Click a target, or move the cursor and press `Enter`. `Esc` cancels.

tips.title: Pick a stat
tips.body: The game is waiting for you. Press `S`, `I` or `D` to raise Strength, Intelligence or Dexterity.

tips.title: You've fallen
tips.body: A teammate can bring you back with a scroll of soul recall. If everyone falls, the expedition ends.

tips.title: A teammate is down
tips.body: Read a scroll of soul recall to bring them back at half health. It lowers their level cap by one.

tips.title: Getting around
tips.body: Click any tile to walk there, or use the arrow keys. A dashed line previews the route first.

tips.title: Tactical combat
tips.body: The turn order shows who acts next. The dungeon waits for your move, so take your time.

tips.title: Size it up first
tips.body: Right-click a creature to read what it can do before you fight it.

tips.title: Enemy in sight
tips.body: Click an enemy next to you to hit it, or press `Tab` to fight the nearest one.

tips.title: Running low on magic
tips.body: Back away or use your weapon. Your magic returns as you rest.

tips.title: Stepping away
tips.body: An enemy next to you may get a free hit when you step away. Retreating is often still the right call.

tips.title: Something you can't see
tips.body: Fight from a corridor so it can only reach you from one side, or leave by the stairs.

tips.title: Plan your moves
tips.body: Shift-click tiles to plan a route step by step, then press Go in the Plan panel.

tips.title: Something's affecting you
tips.body: Hover over the effect icons on your hero card to see what each one does and how long it lasts.

tips.title: Magical contamination
tips.body: Powerful magic has left you glowing. It fades with time, so ease off until it does.

tips.title: A spell went wrong
tips.body: Failed spells can backfire. Check a spell's failure rate first, and remember that heavy armour makes casting harder.

tips.title: The dungeon bites back
tips.body: As you explore, malevolent forces can spring nasty surprises. When one does, stop and think, then use what you have.

tips.title: Watch the clouds
tips.body: Hover over a cloud to see what it is. Some burn or poison you, so wait for them to clear or walk around.

tips.title: You've got company
tips.body: Friendly creatures fight beside you. Press `t` to shout orders at them.

tips.title: Harmless scenery
tips.body: Plants and other still things can't hurt you and give no experience. Walk around them unless they block your way.

tips.title: Catch your breath
tips.body: Press `5` or Rest to recover. Resting costs almost nothing, so start each fight at full health.

tips.title: Something on the ground
tips.body: Press `g` or Pick up to grab what's on this tile.

tips.title: Let your hero explore
tips.body: Press `o` or Explore to walk the floor automatically. You'll stop as soon as something new appears.

tips.title: Floor explored
tips.body: Nothing left to find here. Press `G` or Go to walk to the stairs, then `>` to head deeper.

tips.title: Items nearby
tips.body: Explore picks up most small items as it goes. For weapons and armour, walk onto them and press `g`.

tips.title: New gear
tips.body: Press `i` to open your pack, then choose a weapon, staff or armour to put it to use.

tips.title: Potions
tips.body: Press `q` to drink one. Unknown potions are usually safe to try at full health with no enemies near.

tips.title: Scrolls
tips.body: Press `r` to read one. Try unknown scrolls with no enemies near, because a few cause trouble.

tips.title: Your hero is learning
tips.body: Skills improve as you use them. Press `m` to choose what your hero trains.

tips.title: Casting spells
tips.body: Press `z` to choose a spell, then pick a target. Spells cost MP, which comes back as you rest.

tips.title: A spell to learn
tips.body: You have a spell ready to learn. Press `M` to memorise it.

tips.title: Engraved spells and heat
tips.body: Engraved spells fire on their own and add heat. You cool down as turns pass, and faster once you stop fighting.

tips.title: An altar
tips.body: Stand on it and press `>` to read about its god and choose whether to join them.

tips.title: The Abyss
tips.body: The map won't stay with you here, and everything is dangerous. Look for a way out and leave as soon as you can.

tips.title: The Zot clock
tips.body: The skull column beside your hero fills as time passes. Keep moving to new floors before it reaches the top.

tips.title: Doors
tips.body: Walk into a door to open it. Press `C` to close one behind you.

tips.title: A runed door
tips.body: Runes usually mean something dangerous lies behind it. Monsters won't open it, so go in only when you're ready.

tips.title: An escape hatch
tips.body: Use it with `<` or `>` like stairs, but it's a one-way trip. It's a handy way out of trouble.

tips.title: A side branch
tips.body: This entrance leads to a branch of the dungeon with its own terrain and monsters. Hover over it to learn more.

tips.title: A strange portal
tips.body: Portals lead to optional levels with extra loot and extra danger. Skipping one is fine, but it won't stay open for long.

tips.title: A shop
tips.body: Stand on it and press `>` to browse. This is where your gold gets spent.

tips.title: Trap spotted
tips.body: Explore and Go walk around traps you know about. Take care when you click a route by hand.

tips.title: Spider webs
tips.body: Walking into a web holds you until you struggle free, so go around if you can.

tips.title: Shallow water
tips.body: Fighting here can make you slip and fumble your attacks. Try to fight on firm ground.

tips.title: Wands
tips.body: Press `V` to evoke a wand, then pick a target. Keep them for fights that look bad.

tips.title: Rings and amulets
tips.body: Press `P` to put one on and `R` to take it off.

tips.title: Talismans
tips.body: Press `P` to put one on and change your form.

tips.title: Throwing and shooting
tips.body: Press `f` to fire or throw, then pick a target.

tips.title: Your spell library
tips.body: Books add their spells to your library, shown on your hero card. Press `M` to memorise one when you have room.

tips.title: Useful gadgets
tips.body: Press `V` to evoke it.

tips.title: Keeping faith
tips.body: Press `^` to see what your god likes, dislikes and offers you.

tips.title: Your god is angry
tips.body: Press `^` to see what your god wants. The anger fades in time if you keep to their rules.

tips.title: Special abilities
tips.body: Press `a` to use your hero's abilities. The hero card lists each one.

tips.title: Resistances
tips.body: Press `%` to see your resistances and other defences.

tips.title: Traits and mutations
tips.body: Press `A` to see what makes your hero different.

tips.title: A bane
tips.body: Banes are lasting curses. Hover over one on your hero card to read what it does.

tips.title: Gold
tips.body: You pick up gold just by walking over it. Spend it in shops.

tips.title: A rune of Zot
tips.body: Runes open the way to the Orb of Zot. Press `}` to review what you've found.

tips.title: An ancient gem
tips.body: Each gem is a side challenge that can shatter if you take too long in its branch. Press `}` to check yours.

tips.title: The Orb of Zot
tips.body: This is what you came for. Now get it out of the dungeon alive.

tips.title: Signal your party
tips.body: Choose a signal in the party bar, then click a tile to point it out to your teammates.

tips.title: Party chat
tips.body: Press `F12` to talk to your party.

tips.title: Sharing items
tips.body: Use Trade with party in your inventory to hand an item to a teammate.

tips.title: Splitting up
tips.body: Stairs move only the hero who takes them, and each floor keeps its own time.

tips.title: Several heroes
tips.body: Click a hero's card, or press Next hero at the top, to take control of them.

tips.title: Jev is playing
tips.body: Jev controls this hero. Pause or resume them from their card.

tips.title: How hard do you hit?
tips.body: Press `@` to see your damage and attack speed. It takes no game time.

tips.title: Pack nearly full
tips.body: Your pack holds 52 items. Press `d` to drop what you no longer need.

tips.title: All the keys
tips.body: Press `?` for the full keyboard guide, or open Common hotkeys beside the action row.

tips.title: Stealth and noise
tips.body: Fighting and other loud actions wake nearby monsters. The Noise meter on your hero card shows how loud you are.

tips.title: The whole floor
tips.body: Press `X` to open the level map. Viewing it takes no game time.

tips.title: Moving faster
tips.body: Hold Shift with a direction key to run until something interesting appears.

tips.title: Taking a break
tips.body: Press `Esc` for the game menu. Save and quit keeps your expedition until you come back.

tips.title: Quick actions
tips.body: Use the + slot beside the action row to keep an item, spell or ability one click away.

tips.title: Too big or too small?
tips.body: Use the zoom buttons at the top of the screen. Fit shows your whole view.

tips.title: Missed a message?
tips.body: Press `Ctrl + P` to read the message history.

tips.title: Where was that?
tips.body: Press `Cmd/Ctrl + F` to find any item you've seen in the dungeon.

tips.title: Make it yours
tips.body: Press `Alt + L` to move and resize panels. Your layout is saved in this browser.

tips.title: Keep out
tips.body: Right-click a tile and choose Toggle travel exclusion to keep Explore and Go away from it.
